record.question: For Intravenous Urography the patient is examined in the following EXCEPT:
options: Exposed several times to study flow of contrast to urinary bladder
Plain radiograph obtained at the start of the study
record.explanation: Answer C: Using sonography gel. IV urography uses iodinated contrast and serial radiographs; sonography gel is unrelated. Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/voidcysto; https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/safety-xray. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
